title: a member posts a Proposal; others say they're in or offer to help

criteria.text: A Proposal is a post kind on a Page the member manages: words, an optional goal (a whole number), and an optional list of sizes or options the poster names
criteria.note: A Proposal (internally `wonder`) is a post kind on a Page the member manages: words, an optional whole-number goal, optional sizes; Create's + menu has 'Propose something' (#1094, plan #218). Since 10-30: renamed and the goal made optional (#1150, `Reviewed by:` second session). Checked: `[guards F117.1]` and the optional-goal partial in `tests/wonders-db.test.ts` (whole, DB-gated) [V]. Reviewed: #1081 (v1) is review-skipped with 'Reviewed by: Code agent (build)', so no. Shipped: Deploy health green on dc65fac and 844b8fa. Smoked: unknown; smoke-live was green on 05178ea (11-19; routes explore, page, you; 15 passed) [V gh run] but opens no route that shows this criterion. Re-read 2026-11-20 [V]: #1302 (11-16) changed WonderPanel copy to US spelling and carries 'second session (requested next)', not counted as reviewed; F134 (#1278) made `wonder_view` answer signed-out readers without names.
